name: CinemaCity Quality Lab
description: CinemaCity Quality Lab with adaptive HD download entitlement diagnostics. It tests the user's own official DH endpoint at byte 0 and a safe in-range offset derived from Content-Range, reporting the advertised total size and random-range support.

scrapers.name: CinemaCity Quality · Login Session
scrapers.description: Quality resolver + HDPROBE2. Reports HD qualities exposed by the official sizes endpoint and whether the configured account's official download endpoint supports a second valid byte range. No premium-watch bypass is attempted.
